messages.bodyHtml:
Hello Team Velocity Support and Dan,

We’re requesting an inventory feed for:

Dealership: Maple Grove Volkswagen

Location: Hillsboro, OR

Team Velocity Support:

Please add Maple Grove Volkswagen to the Dealer Addendums inventory feed file and provide the store’s unique Dealer ID once completed.

Once we have your approval and the Dealer ID from Team Velocity, we can complete the setup on our end.

Please let us know if you have any questions. Thank you!

Casey Lane

DealerAddendums.com

801-415-9435
